scientific_question: Does one fixed full-normal correction, preconditioned by the already-frozen v193 signed-sketch Hessian, repair the four remaining strict cells without changing the sketch, adding an exact physical operator call, or training a model?
role: post-open mechanism diagnostic on the same four opened PoolFire frames; this is an iterative sketch-and-refine audit, not a reopening of signed CountSketch capacity and not a deployable or resource result
physical_hypothesis: v193 preserved diffuse signed information but solved only the sketched objective. If its four failures are caused by sketch-Hessian distortion rather than a missing physical direction, one unit full-normal Richardson step using the sealed sketch Hessian should repair them.
physical_distinction: The v193 hash, signs, 1009 anchors, 271 buckets, 1280-channel sketch and seed coordinates remain sealed. v194 adds the deployment-visible full DCT normal residual and applies one fixed preconditioned correction; it does not change or retune the sketch.

already_seen: v189 full camera-resolved DCT K1 is strict-safe in all 104 opened cells
v193 signed CountSketch K1 is strict-safe in 51/52 five-camera and 49/52 all-nine cells
v193 has one five-camera gradient failure and three all-nine observation-only failures
not_read_or_computed_before_this_freeze: any v194 full-normal residual, correction, corrected coordinate, field, physical replay or metric
any v194 diagonal-control or full-sketch-Hessian pass count
pre_result_disclosure.claim_boundary: A pass can establish only post-open iterative-refinement headroom on this four-frame roster. The sealed v189 full-DCT K1 remains an equal-exact-call control and prevents novelty, resource or deployment claims.

data_isolation.development_roster: the same p=22kw_size=01 frames 0,25,75,100, 13 frozen calibrations, five-camera and all-nine arms used by v189-v193
data_isolation.prediction_inputs: sealed v193 signed coordinates plus full camera-resolved detector-potential DCT observations and response matrices rebuilt only from deployment-visible observations, the frozen affine basis and reported geometry
forbidden_inputs: CFD truth, field metrics or pass masks inside the normal residual, Hessian, correction, fallback or stopping
trajectory, frame, time, power or size as an input
line search, damping, step-size search, repeated iterations, ridge, clipping, threshold or candidate choice
a new hash, seed, sign, bucket count, normalization or sketch variant
PoolFire validation/test, real BOST, external data or learned parameters
data_isolation.truth_use: only after both corrected coordinate arrays and fields are sealed, for unchanged physical K1 replay and frozen metrics

fixed_mechanism.seed: the signed_countsketch1280 coordinate sealed by v193, reproduced and byte-compared before correction
fixed_mechanism.full_response: H in R^(1009 x m), the canonical full camera-resolved DCT response rebuilt exactly as v189-v193
fixed_mechanism.full_observation: h in R^(4 x m), the sealed deployment-visible camera-resolved DCT observations
fixed_mechanism.sketch_response: H_s in R^(1009 x 1280), rebuilt using the exact sealed v193 SplitMix64 mapping, signs, anchors and no normalization
fixed_mechanism.primary_correction: delta=r_N (H_s H_s^T)^(-1), computed by float64 SVD with relative singular floor sqrt(float64 epsilon), requiring retained rank 1009
fixed_mechanism.cheap_control_correction: delta_j=r_N,j/diag(H_s H_s^T)_j with the same fixed relative positive floor
fixed_mechanism.final_coordinate: c1=c0+delta with unit step exactly once
fixed_mechanism.camera_permutation_contract: joint camera/ray permutation leaves canonical full features, sketch response, normal residual, correction, coordinate and field unchanged within frozen tolerances
fixed_mechanism.variable_cardinality_contract: the same equations process both five and nine active cameras

evaluation.physical_replay: construct the affine field from the corrected coordinate, then apply the exact unchanged v189-v193 one-step physical CGLS refinement

cost_boundary.dense_online_work_disclosed: both arms read every full DCT observation coordinate, form a dense 1009-coordinate normal residual and apply a dense precomputed 1009x1009 inverse or diagonal
cost_boundary.geometry_cache_disclosed: all full and sketched response matrices and their Hessians are geometry-derived setup artifacts; the inherited full response setup is not free whole-pipeline work
cost_boundary.dominance_control: v189 full-DCT K1 already passes the same opened cells at equal declared exact-call count and must remain visible; v194 cannot establish an operational advantage without later whole-pipeline wall/RSS and broader accuracy evidence
cost_boundary.forbidden_claim: Zero new exact calls for the algebraic correction does not establish lower wall time, memory, setup cost or deployable speedup.

fixed_decision_order: Any binding, isolation, rank, stationarity, noninterference, permutation, replay, call, finite, source or independent-comparison failure makes v194 inconclusive.

If signed_sketch_full_normal_step1_k1 fails any of the 104 strict cells, conclude FAIL_SIGNED_SKETCH_FULL_NORMAL_REFINEMENT_V194 and close this one-step seeded full-normal mechanism; do not add iterations, tune a step, ridge, damping or sketch settings.

If the full-Hessian primary passes all 104 strict cells and the diagonal control also passes all 104, conclude PASS_DIAGONAL_NORMAL_CONTROL_HEADROOM_V194 and prefer the cheaper control in any separately frozen follow-up.
If only the full-Hessian primary passes all 104 strict cells, conclude PASS_SIGNED_SKETCH_FULL_NORMAL_HEADROOM_V194.
Any pass is only post-open mechanism headroom and does not authorize a model, GPU, validation/test opening, resource claim or paper claim.

must_rebuild: full response and deployment-visible full DCT observations
the exact sealed v193 signed sketch and seed coordinates
full normal residuals and both fixed corrections using an eigensolver independent of the formal SVD path
corrected fields, unchanged physical K1, exact call receipts and strict metrics
all parent and input seals before and after validation

authorization_boundary.if_independent_primary_passes: authorize only a separately frozen complete-trajectory development comparison against the cheaper diagonal and sealed full-DCT controls
authorization_boundary.if_primary_fails: close the one-step signed-sketch full-normal mechanism and do not tune or repeat it
not_authorized: CNN, FNO, UNO, DeepONet or larger-model rescue
opening PoolFire validation/test or an external gate
